topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture themes and outline the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumour Virology and the Discovery of Transforming Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming viruses established that cancer arises from altered cellular genes and led to experimental assays for transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes and Tumour Suppressor Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions and genetic mechanisms of oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes in regulating the cell cycle and determining mutant cellular phenotypes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the forms of sequence and chromosomal instability, their origins in defective DNA repair and mitosis, and their role in driving multistep tumour progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumour Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development and influence ongoing tumour evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks conclude the lecture with recommended reading and an outlook on the next topic.
